figures.caption: Figure 1: Comparative analysis of feature generation mechanisms and interpretability paradigms across Aut- oFE. Traditional AutoFE rely on blind operator stacks, yielding high performance but poor interpretability. LLM-based AutoFE offer semantic clarity but may suffer from performance instability. Our proposed SymboLLM-FE synergizes symbolic regression with LLMs to achieve both high predictive accuracy and human-interpretable transparency.
